shots.say: In Alaska, moose injure more people than bears do.
A calf weighs up to 400 pounds by winter.
One even got stuck in a swimming pool.
If it charges, run behind a tree. He picked a small one.
Subscribe. Next: the wasp that walks a cockroach home.
